column7: REVIEW-SERVERGUARD-RECOVERYKEY-1 F4: deleting or replacing the SQLite <db>.server.lock sidecar while a server held it left the server's flock on the deleted inode, so the next admin command (restore, migrate, recover-admin, clear-login-lockout) created a new file and took the exclusive lock beside the live server. The server now checks every 5 s that the path names the inode it holds and re-takes LOCK_SH on the new file (TestSQLitePresence_DeletedSidecarIsTakenAgain, TestSQLitePresence_ReplacedSidecarIsTakenAgain) or closes Presence.Lost so it stops when an admin holds it first (internal/serverguard/serverguard_sidecar_watch_test.go).
